name: Alert Pullrope
description: Shovel earth and stone into the counterweight box in even layers until the crew calls the weight true.

name: Rallying Longarm
description: Tap the loaded box with a mallet and listen to the sound to judge whether the ballast has settled evenly.

name: Quickening Releasehook
description: Seat the box hanger pins in their sockets with a hammer and key them so the box cannot swing loose.

name: Cooling Slingpouch
description: Wind the long arm down until the loaded box rises to its set height with qi steadying the back.

name: Pulleycordial
description: Align the pin hook to the arm's rise so the sling leaves the pin at the proper moment in the swing.

name: Tackleglide
description: Step wide of the descending box as it falls so the loaded weight never passes near the head.

name: Rough Fulcrum
description: Trip the pin and let the loaded box fall so the long arm whips up and flings the shot in a steady high curve.

name: Sure Tackle
description: Drive a shoulder and a surge of qi into the arm stop to halt an overswing before the frame takes harm.

name: Tacklebandage
description: Pack the hinge pin with tallow and turn it by hand until the weight swings free and without catch.

name: Tacklecordial
description: Sight along the hanging box against the frame to confirm it hangs plumb and does not drag a post.

name: Sure Ballast
description: Count the box's free swing in breaths during a slow lowering so the crew learns the period of the throw.

name: Stalwart Hangcradle
description: Hold a low guard with the forearm raised on the hinge side to turn aside splinters from a failing pin.

name: Rude Letgo
description: Strike out a stuck hinge key with a short hammer blow driven by the whole turn of the hips.

name: Heaveoff Slap
description: Release as the swinging weight lags behind the arm so the long arm snaps through and flings a flatter shot.

name: Armbuckle
description: Slide a crossed forearm along a flung hinge pin and turn it past the shoulder as the box drops.

name: Sprout Hangcradle
description: Stand with the feet apart and the weight low beside the engine so a long swing does not unbalance the crew.

name: Dawn Rigging
description: Coil the sling cord in the hand in a loose spiral that pays out in a straight line without tangling.

name: Ballast Cordial
description: Rest the shot in the pouch at the arm tip so it sits low before the whip begins.

name: Brawnpulley
description: Roll the wrist with a thread of qi along the forearm to snap the cord at the exact top of the arc.

name: Humpulley
description: Fix the eyes on the peak of the arm's travel and feel the moment the cord comes taut.

name: Genial Pullrope
description: Hear the crack of the sling cord straightening and tell from its pitch whether the cast was early or late.

name: Fleet Swing
description: Step aside into the dust the arm throws up and keep the body out of the line of a loose cord.

name: Shardswing
description: Whip the cord around the arm tip at the swing's top so the shot leaves with a sharp crack and long flat flight.

name: Cruel Whiplash
description: Lob the shot with a high looped whip that drops steeply over a rampart lip onto the ground behind it.

name: Poise Fulcrum
description: Throw the cord clear of the shoulder with a flick when a frayed strand parts mid-cast and whips back.

name: Sure Shortarm
description: File the pin hook to a shorter bill so the sling frees earlier and the shot leaves low.

name: Pulleylinen
description: Sight along the trough to the target line and judge how low the shot will pass over the ground.

name: Stubborn Rigging
description: Crouch the crew behind the frame on the release so the backwash of a flat shot passes overhead.

name: Grim Shortarm
description: Pull the trip with a sharp downward tug that frees the short hook and drives the shot in a hard flat line.

name: Keen Slingpouch
description: Release low so the shot strikes the earth short of the ranks and skips on in a bounding line through them.

name: Tackle Swerve
description: Drop and shuffle sideways behind the sill as the arm sweeps low so no head is caught in its wash.

name: Sprout Longarm
description: Rank the pullers by strength so the strongest stand at the head of the rope and the weakest at its tail.

name: Tenderhearted Tackle
description: Lean back along the haul rope on a shared breath so every puller's weight lands on the same instant.

name: Tacklelinen
description: Judge by the creak of the beam butt how far down it has been hauled and call the last paces to the stop.

name: Sprout Releasehook
description: Rake a shallow trench behind each puller's heels so the feet find a purchase on loose ground.

name: Lunar Slingpouch
description: Count the descent of the beam in even beats so the whole team knows when the arm reaches the notch.

name: Buttressed Longarm
description: Wrap the palms in wet cloth so the pull and the sudden slide of the rope do not strip the skin.

name: Rushing Swing
description: Let every puller run the rope out on a single call so the beam is flung up and the shot thrown free.

name: Kindly Rigging
description: Hold the pull-team braced against a rope that jerks mid-haul and keep the beam from dropping early.

name: Letgocurl
description: On release the nearest pullers peel off the rope's end and step clear in the order the captain calls.

name: Rallying Fulcrum
description: Cut a flat step in a slope with spades and lay the sill on it so the engine sits level.

name: Sproutpulley
description: Bed the sill on packed planks over soft mud so the weight of the engine does not sink it.

name: Poisepulley
description: Chock the downhill end of the sill with stones and timber against a slide when the beam is wound.

name: Kindly Pullrope
description: Press a hand to the earth to feel whether the soil gives or shifts at each winding of the beam.

name: Brawn Releasehook
description: Scatter sand and chaff across a muddy yard so the crew keeps its footing during the pull.

name: Soothing Shortarm
description: Hang a plumb weight beside an upright and read its drift to find which post settled in the night.

name: Sleetswing
description: Aim up or down along a grade by shifting the release timing so the shot still lands at the wanted distance.

name: Clayarm
description: Drive a spike of timber under a sinking sill mid-battle and lean the shoulders into it to hold the engine.

name: Gaptackle
description: Hang a strip of cloth from the frame and read its lean to know the crosswind across the field.

name: Candorpulley
description: Peg a line beside the range mark to show how far the wind shifts a shot of each weight.

name: Hum Ballast
description: Run the hand along a cable wet with dew to feel how far it has stretched and loosened its set.

name: Brawn Fulcrum
description: Lash a waxed sheet over the winch and drum so rain does not swell the cable on the drum.

name: Sure Releasehook
description: Hold the beam wound and the crew still through a gust until the wind drops and the order comes.

name: Sleet Whiplash
description: Aim the shot upwind of the mark by a measured offset so the gust carries it onto the target.

name: Pulleytonic
description: Wring the cable between cloths with a surge of qi in the forearms before each winding so it grips the drum.

name: Hearty Hangcradle
description: Fill sacks with rounded river pebbles of even size and tie each sack so it will not burst in the pouch.

name: Knitting Hangcradle
description: Pack the loose stones in the pouch in a flat bed so they leave the sling together and not in a stream.

name: Recall Longarm
description: Weigh the small stones in the hand and sort the light from the heavy so the load flies as a body.

name: Hum Pullrope
description: Test the sling cords against a double load before a mixed throw since the cord carries more than one stone.

name: Brawnarm
description: Stitch the pouch seams twice with waxed thread so the weight of many stones cannot split the leather.

name: Hearty Tackle
description: Draw the pouch mouth nearly shut with a cord that slips free as the sling snaps open.

name: Rubble Counterswing
description: Fling the loaded pouch high so the pebbles open into a spreading cloud that falls across a small stretch of ranks.

name: Weighty Overthrow
description: Throw a low-arced load that rakes the front of a column and forces the ranks to bow their heads and slow.

name: Brass Shortarm
description: Drop under a raised forearm and a ring of qi when a split pouch showers stones back across the crew.
